result.note: Tests the August 2026 Medium Transport Aircraft tender: its scope, the An-32 fleet it replaces, and the industry partnerships announced.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the Medium Transport Aircraft (MTA) tender issued by the Ministry of Defence in August 2026:
items: It seeks 60 transport aircraft with an 18-30 tonne cargo capacity.
The tender is valued at INR 1 trillion.
It invites Indian companies to partner with global manufacturers to build the aircraft.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three statements match the tender issued on 12 August 2026. Selection could take more than two years given the scale of the technical and commercial evaluation.
questions.source: Issued on August 12, the Medium Transport Aircraft (MTA) programme invites Indian companies to partner with global manufacturers to build 60 transport aircraft with an 18-30 tonne cargo capacity.

questions.prompt: The Medium Transport Aircraft programme, for which a tender was floated in August 2026, is intended to replace which Indian Air Force fleet?
questions.explain: The new aircraft will replace the Antonov An-32 fleet, which has been in service for three decades. An An-32 was involved in a fatal crash in June 2026 that killed five personnel.
questions.source: The aircraft will replace the Indian Air Force's Antonov An-32 fleet, in service for three decades and involved in a fatal crash in June that killed five personnel.

questions.prompt: Consider the following pairs relating to partnerships announced for India's Medium Transport Aircraft tender in August 2026:
items: Tata Advanced Systems Limited — Lockheed Martin
questions.ask: How many of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.explain: The KC-390 Millennium is Embraer's aircraft, not Lockheed Martin's. Lockheed Martin, partnered with TASL, is pitching the C-130J Super Hercules.
questions.source: TASL has tied up with Lockheed Martin to pitch its C-130J Super Hercules, and Mahindra Defense has teamed up with Embraer, which has pitched its KC-390 Millennium aircraft to India.
